Hi Emma — great questions, and thanks for the usage file. High level, there are two pragmatic paths we see work best for customers in your situation:

Option A — Throughput-first + Feature Add-ons (recommended if latency is the primary driver)
- Reserved throughput pool sized to cover your 95th-percentile peak (we'll size based on the CSV).
- Add the premium feature bundle as an opt-in add-on (structured outputs + function calling enhancements). The add-on is metered separately from throughput so you don't lose features when you consume less tokens.
- Downgrade protection: standard stepdown window (first 90 days) allows one penalty-free re-sizing; after that, changes are permitted with a 30-day notice and prorated credits for unused reservation.

Option B — Modular seat/tier + Pilot Reserved Month
- Keep current modular tier for the services that need occasional premium features, but pilot a single service on Dedicated reserved throughput for 30–60 days (pilot credits apply).
- If pilot shows throughput justification, convert to full reserved pool with a migration credit.

What I need from you to make a firm quote: expected committed tokens/month per service (or just total expected committed tokens), target P95 latency SLO, and whether you need multi-region coverage.

Quick proposal we can put in front of your CFO by Friday:
- 12-month reservation with 15% volume discount on reserved throughput + feature add-on priced at list with a 1-month migration credit equal to 25% of month-1 reserved fees.
- One complimentary pilot month (limited to one service) for new throughput reservations.
- Downgrade stepdown: single re-size w/o penalty within 90 days; subsequent reductions prorated and eligible for credit up to 50% of unused committed spend (per standard T&Cs).

If that looks close, I can loop in pricing and legal to get a term sheet and draft quote.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Soojin — quick internal note on negotiation levers before you send a formal term sheet to Emma:

1) Discount bands: 12-month commitment -> baseline 12–15% (volume dependent). If they commit to >3x current baseline tokens, push to 18%.
2) Migration credit: approve up to 25% of month-1 reserved fees as a one-time credit (covers engineering migration costs).
3) Downgrade protections: offer one penalty-free re-size within first 90 days; after that, permit stepdown with 30-day notice and prorated credit up to 50% of unused committed spend. Avoid blanket early-termination credits beyond the migration credit.
4) Pilot concession: 1 complimentary pilot month limited to a single service—no SLA guarantee during pilot (explicitly call out).
5) Feature bundling: price features as add-ons (not included in reserved throughput) to avoid bundling complexity and preserve ability to charge for premium capabilities.

Approve the language Soojin drafted but add explicit callouts for approval path: anything that delivers >20% off list or extends penalty-free re-sizes beyond 90 days requires Sales Leader (me) + RevOps sign-off.

If you want, use the following line in your external email to speed approval: "We can confirm a 15% committed discount with a one-time migration credit equal to 25% of month-1 reserved fees; one penalty-free re-size within 90 days."

Ben

- Pilot: one complimentary pilot month for a single service (60-day window to convert).
- Downgrade protections: one penalty-free re-size within 90 days; subsequent reductions require 30-day notice and are eligible for prorated credit up to 50% of unused committed spend.
